pages.title: Vent Biofilm
pages.text: A mat of bacteria that live on chemistry instead of light: hydrogen and sulfide from the vents, turned into food. The first link of the hidden ocean's food chain. Dropped by Vent Grazers in Titan's hidden ocean.
$(thing)Dropped by$(): Ice Eel, Vent Crab, Vent Grazer.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Abyssal Silicate, Bacterial Culture, Stable Ecosystem.
